children: Avantor has hired Todd Garner as its new executive vice president and chief financial officer.
Avantor on Monday said Garner previously served as executive vice president and finance chief of Conmed, which announced his planned departure earlier this year.

The Radnor, Pa., provider of products and services to the life-sciences and advanced-technology industries said Steve Eck, who has been serving as interim chief financial officer since R. Brent Jones left in June to take another position, will continue as chief accounting officer.
